mapper.sql: totals AS ( SELECT s.id AS student_id, COALESCE(SUM(sc.score), 0) AS total FROM student s LEFT JOIN student_score sc ON sc.student_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id ), ranked AS ( SELECT t.student_id, t.total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.grade ORDER BY t.total DESC) AS grade_rank FROM totals t JOIN student s ON s.id = t.student_id JOIN class_info c ON c.class_id = s.class_id ), att_stat AS ( SELECT a.student_id, SUM(a.status = '出勤') AS present, SUM(a.status = '迟到') AS late, SUM(a.status = '缺勤') AS absent, SUM(a.status = '请假') AS leave_cnt FROM attendance_record a GROUP BY a.student_id )

s.id, s.sid, s.name, s.gender, s.status, s.phone, s.guardian, s.guardian_relation, s.guardian_phone, s.birthday, s.enrollment_date, s.address, s.dorm, s.note, c.class_id, c.class_name, c.grade, c.grade_index, c.class_no, r.total, r.grade_rank, COALESCE(a.present, 0) AS present, COALESCE(a.late, 0) AS late, COALESCE(a.absent, 0) AS absent, COALESCE(a.leave_cnt, 0) AS `leave`
FROM student s JOIN class_info c ON c.class_id = s.class_id JOIN ranked r ON r.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN att_stat a ON a.student_id = s.id

sql.if: LEFT JOIN student_score sc_sort ON sc_sort.student_id = s.id AND sc_sort.subject_key = #{subjectKey}

if.test: grade != null and grade != '' and grade != '全部'
classId != null and classId != '' and classId != '全部'
status != null and status != '' and status != '全部'

where.if: AND (s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.sid LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.guardian LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.guardian_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

choose.when: ORDER BY s.name DESCASC, s.sid ASC
ORDER BY c.grade_index DESCASC, c.class_no DESCASC, s.sid ASC
ORDER BY r.total DESCASC, s.sid ASC
ORDER BY COALESCE(sc_sort.score, 0) DESCASC, s.sid ASC

mapper.select: WITH SELECT COUNT(*) AS student_count, AVG(r.total) AS avg_total, MAX(r.total) AS best_total, COALESCE(SUM(r.total >= #{passLine}), 0) AS pass_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.total >= #{excellentLine}), 0) AS excellent_count

WITH SELECT
ORDER BY r.total DESC, s.sid ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, sid, name, gender, class_id, status, phone, guardian, guardian_relation, guardian_phone, birthday, enrollment_date, address, dorm, note, created_at, updated_at FROM student WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (sid, name, gender, class_id, status, phone, guardian, guardian_relation, guardian_phone, birthday, enrollment_date, address, dorm, note) VALUES (#{sid}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{classId}, #{status}, #{phone}, #{guardian}, #{guardianRelation}, #{guardianPhone}, #{birthday}, #{enrollmentDate}, #{address}, #{dorm}, #{note})
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET sid = #{sid}, name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, class_id = #{classId}, status = #{status}, phone = #{phone}, guardian = #{guardian}, guardian_relation = #{guardianRelation}, guardian_phone = #{guardianPhone}, birthday = #{birthday}, enrollment_date = #{enrollmentDate}, address = #{address}, dorm = #{dorm}, note = #{note} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student WHERE id IN #{id}
